values.note: Campspot, one night for 2 adults, June 2027 (Tuesday and Saturday alike): Full Hook-Up RV Site $35 - the only RV site type Campspot offers to a Class C motorhome. The Primitive ($30) and Water and Electric ($35) 'Tent / Small RV' sites and the Electric 'Hook to Cabin' sites are offered to pop-ups and tents only. The park adds a 4% 'Booking Fee' on the site charge (about $1.40 a night); Campspot adds its own 3% (min $3) per booking. Cabins $60-112, 2-night minimum.

note: Family-owned since 1932, on Long Lake near Burr Oak, with fishing piers, a boat launch, dock slips, a swimming beach, and modern and rustic cabins. Mostly seasonal: about 16 of its ~143 sites are sold by the night, and only the 3 full-hookup ones are offered to motorhomes (Campspot, 2026-10-22). --Claude
summary: No website of its own: steinkeresort.com redirects to the Campspot listing, and the operator's engine is campspot.com/book/steinke-resort. Changed fees 30-35 -> 35/35: the $30 primitive and $35 W/E 'Tent / Small RV' types are offered only to pop-ups/tents, so the base is the $35 full-hookup site, the one type listing a Class C. Confirmed 30-amp/water/sewer and the May 1 - Sept 30 season (closed from 2026-10-01 to 2027-04-30). Added max 30 ft and the nightly-site breakdown; booking URL is the /book/ link. Google: open, 4.7 / 81 reviews, phone matches.
flags: Website is the Campspot marketplace slug https://www.campspot.com/park/steinke-resort-burr-oak-mi; the operator's own Campspot booking link is https://www.campspot.com/book/steinke-resort (its domain steinkeresort.com just redirects to Campspot). Mostly seasonal (long-stay five tests): Campspot sells 16 sites by the night against ~143 sites (count from note prose/a travel guide, the operator doesn't state one) = ~11%, so test 4 passes narrowly; only 3 of those (full hookup, to 30 ft) are offered to a Class C motorhome. Price $35 + 4% park fee = ~$36.40 < $50 (test 1); one night bookable online with no RV minimum (tests 2-3); no homes or lots for sale seen (test 5). No gateway needed; never stayed.
